synchronous_mode: a commit is acknowledged only after the sync standby has it, so the promoted node
has every acknowledged write. Tested under load by deploy/db-ha-e2e.test.mjs. The services restart
on their own (restart: unless-stopped) if a failover catches their start-up migration.
